name: PharmaTrader
description_en:
PharmaTrader is a product in the Accounting category. Its directory profile covers Payroll Management, Tax Management, Spend Management, Purchasing, Project Accounting, Fixed Asset Management, Billing and Invoicing, Accounts Receivable.

Additional listed capabilities include Accounts Payable. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep).

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: prepare payroll records and payment calculations; organize tax-related records and calculations; prepare invoices and track billing records; track amounts owed by customers; track amounts owed to suppliers and other payees. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
PharmaTrader 属于会计与记账软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括薪资管理、税务管理、支出管理、采购、项目会计、固定资产管理、账单与开票、应收账款。

资料还列出应付账款。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：整理薪资记录并计算工资支付；整理税务相关记录与计算；制作发票并跟踪账单记录；跟踪客户尚未支付的款项；跟踪应向供应商等收款方支付的款项。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
